ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:5 ratio of high-intensity white/grey pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the total visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The left lobe distal region contains a large, wedge-shaped region of heterogeneous grey-white mottled pixels. The right lobe is predominantly uniform low-intensity black with minimal pixel variance.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations with a pixel-amplitude of 3-10 pixels along the entire trailing edge boundary; right lobe exhibits larger, irregular jagged peaks near the distal end.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a concave sweep from the central notch area transitioning to a moderate convex curve toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white circular pixel groups (barnacles) are concentrated on the distal tips of both lobes; the right tip contains a dense grouping of approximately 10-14 discrete points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle vertical linear pixel disruptions are visible on the surface of the right lobe, appearing as low-contrast parallel streaks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular V-shaped traumatic indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe, distinct from natural serrations; significant barnacle colonization on both distal lobe tips.
